sloka: रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुलम् आत्मानम् एव च ।आचचक्षे द्विजः तस्मै सर्वभूत समुद्भवम् ॥३-१४-५॥
transliteration: rāmasya vacanam śrutvā kulam ātmānam eva ca ।ācacakṣe dvijaḥ tasmai sarvabhūta samudbhavam ॥3-14-5॥

translations.english: On hearing Rama's words, the bird started narrating the origin of all beings including his own family:
